content.short: Swapper Finance converts any asset on any chain into a trade-ready stablecoin balance.
content.description: Swapper takes any asset on any chain and delivers a trade-ready stablecoin balance at a destination the integrator chooses. An integrator registers, sets the destination chain, token and receiving wallet address, then embeds the widget as an iframe, modal or inline component. Users connect a wallet or deposit directly, and Swapper handles the conversion and routing in between.
content.meta: Turns an inbound asset from any chain into a trade-ready stablecoin balance.
